title: Croatian-Style Mushroom Pilaf
description: A hearty and earthy pilaf filled with sautéed mushrooms and a hint of Croatian flair.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the mushrooms and sauté for 3-4 minutes until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the pilaf and stir to combine with the mushrooms.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the pilaf is lightly toasted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
